Barn Accessible Bodywork for Equines and Equestrians
Hawaii Horse Massage is dedicated to making it easy for people to include high-quality, professional bodywork as a part of their regular routine by providing exceptional bodywork services to horses and their humans, collaborating with other equine professionals, and educating horse owners about bodywork.
